This Guide will explain how to access an entire team's 1 rep max and 1 rep power max.

# Set up API Token

Below is the code to set up your API Token. Please reference the [Get Started Guide](getting-started.Rmd).

```{r , eval = FALSE}
# Load the eliteformR package
library(eliteformR)

token <- EF_CreateAPIToken(Sys.getenv("ELITEFORM_API_KEY"))

# Download Team List
team_list_df <- EF_GetTeamsList(token)

# Update the Token with the Selected Team ID
token <- EF_UpdateTokenTeam(token, team_list_df$id[1])
# or
# token <- EF_UpdateTokenTeam(token, 111)
```

# Get Team's Current 1 Rep Max

To gather your Team's current 1 rep maxes, you will require just the token. `result` is in the exercise's weight unit, and `isPredicted` says whether the max was predicted by EliteForm or entered by a coach.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
Team1RepMax_df <- EF_Get1RMs(token)

Team1RepMax_df

#     id athleteId exerciseId teamId result isPredicted       date
# 1 4117        13         88      1    365       FALSE 2026-01-12
# 2 4130        13         91      1    245       FALSE 2026-01-12
# 3 4388         6         88      1    415        TRUE 2026-04-03

# Only coach-entered maxes, as they stood on July 1
EF_Get1RMs(token, isPredicted = FALSE, dateBefore = "2026-07-01")
```

# Get Team's Current Power 1 Rep Max

To gather your Team's current power 1 rep maxes, you will require just the token. Power is in watts.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
Power.Team1RepMax_df <- EF_GetPower1RMs(token)

Power.Team1RepMax_df

#    id athleteId exerciseId teamId averagePower peakPower       date
# 1 912         6         95      1         1184      2310 2026-02-03
# 2 913        13         95      1         1052      1975 2026-02-03
```

# Adding Names

Maxes identify athletes and exercises by ID. Join them to the roster and the exercise list for names and weight units:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
named_df <- merge(Team1RepMax_df, EF_GetAthleteInfo(token)[, c("athleteId", "firstName", "lastName")], by = "athleteId")
named_df <- merge(named_df, EF_GetExercises(token)[, c("id", "name", "weightUnit")], by.x = "exerciseId", by.y = "id")
```
